It is the policy of this state to encourage sister-city agreements between governmental entities and countries that are allies of the United States, including countries designated as major non-NATO allies under federal law and the Republic of China, commonly known as Taiwan, and communities located in those countries.
A governmental entity may not establish, maintain, or renew a sister-city agreement with:
(1) a country that is a foreign adversary; or
(2) a community located in a country described by Subdivision (1).
For expiration of this section, see Subsection (b).
(a) A governmental entity that on September 1, 2025, is a party to a sister-city agreement described by Section 795.003 shall withdraw from the agreement not later than October 1, 2025.
